rules: Continue an active implementation PR before opening later core-lane or child-lane scope.
Do not advance the current child until its acceptance criteria and required checks are green.
Stop at unresolved owner gates documented in docs/DECISION_GATES.md; do not silently choose scope/product decisions.
Run preregistered engineering checkpoints before the scored B0 cohort where specified.
Do not mutate or rerun a frozen scored benchmark cohort to improve its score.
Public pull-request CI must not execute on the owner home self-hosted runner.
P8-X0 AssetSet/batch authoring must reuse the proven single-asset pipeline, isolate member failures, and keep execution concurrency explicit and bounded.
P8-R0 unfamiliar-form research must produce retained, versioned, digest-pinned reusable profile evidence before generation can rely on it; research/profile context never becomes raster authority.
P8-B0 batch requests must digest-bind every declared member to a validated single-asset request and derive an immutable declared-order bounded-concurrency schedule before execution.

P8-B1 must retain per-member and aggregate provider-call, input-token, output-token, retry/repair, cache, and wall-time telemetry sufficient for the mandatory P8-C0 cost-scaling checkpoint; P8-B1 must hand off to P8-C0, never directly to P8-B2.

P8-C0 must prove batch orchestration adds no hidden provider/token multiplier: all provider calls and tokens are attributable to member executions, successful siblings are not restarted by another member failure, concurrency stays bounded, aggregate budgets are enforced, and any batch-specific wall-time overhead is retained and reported before P8-B2 or later breadth work may begin.

P8-C0 is not allowed to claim that B1's roughly 4.6-5.1x single-asset staged cost is solved merely because batching is bounded; it must separately show that AssetSet execution does not add another uncontrolled multiplier on top of that known per-member cost.

P8-B2 must require one exact digest-pinned style profile across every AssetSet member; palette profiles, when used, must bind the whole set consistently. Profile identity is deterministic evidence, while visual style/palette similarity remains perceptual evidence unless a separately frozen measurable rule exists.

P8-B3 must prove representative item-icon and scene-prop members can coexist in one AssetSet through the existing validated request, schedule, consistency, and isolated-execution seams without a second authoring path, new provider work, or new raster authority; member-specific canvas/composition remains independent while exact shared-style binding is preserved.

P8-B4 must prove a representative terrain-tile family can reuse the same bounded single-asset AssetSet path with one exact tile grid plus shared style/palette bindings, while retained semantic edge intent fails closed on mismatched internal neighbors; semantic adjacency is deterministic evidence but visual pixel seamlessness remains perceptual evidence for P8-B5.

G7/G8/G9 are owner-approved long-term destinations as of 2026-08-17, but no creature, humanoid, or animation implementation belongs in P8; promotions occur only after P8-B6 through dedicated sequential post-P8 gates with creature evidence before humanoid and humanoid evidence before animation.

P10 opens only after the frozen P8-B6 postmortem and the recorded G7 owner approval. P10-C0 is contract-only: it must freeze morphology/species-profile, pose/constraint, perceptual-evidence, and complexity-accounting boundaries before any creature raster generation or provider execution is permitted.

P10 creature work must reuse the existing single-asset PixelProgram/Canvas authoring authority. Morphology and pose data are digest-pinned authoring constraints/evidence, never a second raster authority or physical-simulation engine.

P10-C4 real creature provider execution is owner-triggered on the trusted self-hosted runner only; portable PR CI remains provider-free, and retained output must preserve provider/token/iteration/edit/QA/repair/profile-reuse/failure evidence without adding hidden scheduler work or a second raster authority.
P10-C5 freezes the owner-accepted simple-creature evidence and authorizes only the dedicated G8 humanoid contract lane; it does not itself authorize humanoid provider/raster execution.

G8 opens only after frozen P10-C5 owner-accepted evidence and the recorded G8 owner approval. G8-H0 is contract-only: it must freeze anatomy/proportion/identity, static pose/equipment-anchor, perceptual-evidence, complexity-accounting, and authority boundaries before any humanoid provider execution or raster generation is permitted.

G8 humanoid work must reuse the existing single-asset PixelProgram/Canvas authoring authority. Anatomy/identity profiles, pose constraints, and equipment anchors are digest-pinned authoring constraints/evidence, never a second raster authority, skeletal simulation authority, inverse-kinematics engine, or equipment-specific drawing engine.

G8-H4 is the earliest child that may perform retained real humanoid provider/raster work, and only after H1-H3 contracts are green; portable PR CI must remain provider-free and full provider/token/iteration/edit/QA/repair/profile-reuse/failure evidence must be retained.
G9 animation/multi-frame implementation remains blocked until G8 static-humanoid evidence is frozen; G8 must not pull animation forward.
Trace2D integration remains deferred until independent benchmark evidence and explicit owner approval justify it.
